title: Impact of Percutaneous Laparoscopic Assisted Internal Ring Ligation During Lap Orchiopexy
brief_summary: Impact of percutaneous internal ring ligation during laparoscopic orchiopexy in decreasing incidence of congenital hernia
raw_criteria:
* INCLUSION CRITERIA

  1. Age above six months
  2. SEX must be male
  3. Surgical approach is closure of internal ring via percutaneous technique after delivery of undescended testis
* EXCLUSION CRITERIA

  1. Age less than 3 months
  2. Patients with palpable undescended testis
  3. Any associated major congenital anomalies like cardiac anomalies
